g.text: B ARTON ST. E A ST
Hamilton General Hospital is located at 237 Barton St E, Hamilton. On Level 2 (ground level), there are elevators, an information desk, gift shop, coffee shop, emergency
department, and bridge to the parking garage with accessible parking spaces. The main entrance and emergency department entrance are wheelchair accessible. For
information about specific locations, please call your clinic’s extension or the main hospital switchboard at 905.521.2100. When you arrive, please visit the information desk in
the main lobby if you require assistance.
B ARTON ST. E A ST
